#### 2. Portable reasoning resolution (provider, ~5h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Cline #12946 portable reasoning resolution. LLM gateway previously translated reasoning independently for Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Ollama, Codex CLI, and several model families. Moved reasoning effort and enablement onto AI SDK's top-level `reasoning` option and removed redundant provider-specific routing. Centralized `resolvePortableReasoning` maps effort levels (low/medium/high) to AI SDK reasoning options, normalizes max to xhigh, explicit enablement to medium, and explicit disable to none. Removes portable reasoning before composing provider options to avoid precedence conflicts. Retained provider-specific routing only for exact token budgets and native disable controls that cannot be represented portably.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable. Alexi has provider-specific reasoning for DeepSeek (src/providers/deepseek.ts buildDeepSeekRequest 78 lines, reasoning_effort dispatch on per-model capability, sends reasoning_effort as-is for "levels" mode deepseek-reasoner, sends enable_thinking: true and drops reasoning_effort for "binary" mode deepseek-v3, does nothing for "none" mode unknown modelId), SAP AI Core (src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts 685 lines, mentions reasoning in line 420 comment "reasoning) — the turn is NOT empty"), and adaptive thinking (src/providers/adaptiveThinking.ts 12KB). Alexi does not have centralized portable reasoning resolver (check src/providers/ for resolvePortableReasoning returns nothing). Size ~5h: create src/providers/reasoning.ts with centralized portable reasoning resolver (export resolvePortableReasoning(effortLevel: 'low'|'medium'|'high'|'max', enabled?: boolean) => AISDKReasoningOption; map low/medium/high to AI SDK reasoning option; normalize max to xhigh; handle enabled=true to medium, enabled=false to none; return undefined when no reasoning requested), wire into src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts and src/providers/deepseek.ts (import resolvePortableReasoning, call before provider-specific customization, remove redundant effort routing for portable cases, retain SAP-specific controls like budget or native disable that cannot be represented portably, remove provider options.reasoning before composing providerOptions to avoid precedence conflicts), add tests (effort mapping low/medium/high/max, enablement to medium, disable to none, no reasoning returns undefined, provider-specific overrides preserved when non-portable). Category: provider. Priority: MODERATE (architecture cleanup, reduces duplication across providers, aligns with AI SDK portable reasoning API https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/ai-sdk-core/reasoning).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12946 "feat(llms): add portable reasoning resolution for AI SDK providers" (merged 2026-08-05T19:17:49Z, commit `1d7d9ce`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12946. Removes redundant effort routing for Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini/Vertex, Fireworks, OpenRouter, Ollama, GLM, MiniMax, Moonshot/Kimi, Together, Codex CLI. Updated integration and routing tests for new request shape.
- **Category**: provider. **Size**: ~5h. **Priority**: MODERATE.

#### 4. sdk.error model attribution (telemetry, ~2h, SKIP)

- **What**: Cline #12972 sdk.error model attribution. Of ~83k sdk.error events over 7 days, ~35k carried no model attribution. agent.run error telemetry (AgentRuntime.emit passes context: metadata) now spreads active model (getTelemetryProviderId() / getTelemetryModelId()) into event context under providerId/modelId keys so dbt's existing coalesce picks them up. This capture site owns failures the model layer didn't self-report (custom AgentModels that flatten errors into finish events, loop-originated failures).
- **Why**: Alexi does not have centralized telemetry infrastructure. grep 'sdk.error|telemetry.*error|error.*telemetry' in src/ returned nothing. Alexi has ErrorBackoff (src/core/error-backoff.ts), error logging (src/utils/logger.ts), but no sdk.error event emission. Skip (no telemetry infra).
- **Source**: Cline PR #12972 "fix(telemetry): attribute agent.run sdk.error events to the active model" (merged 2026-08-06T00:51:06Z, commit `543dd0d`). Full PR body at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/12972. Extended agent-runtime.test.ts: runtime constructed with messageModelInfo, asserts providerId/modelId land on event.
- **Category**: telemetry. **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: SKIP.
